description: OAuth correlation is exclusively server-side state: initiation mints a single-use state (15 min TTL); the callback carries ONLY state+code (no alias/connection id); unknown state is rejected 400 invalid_oauth_state; a real state with a fake authorization code advances the pending connection request to failed (provider token exchange rejected) — full provider round-trip requires real provider credentials (blocked-env for the happy path only).

environment.database: sqlite at OOMOL_CONNECT_DATA_DIR=/tmp/oc-t01-data-a (throwaway, deleted after probes)
environment.runtime_auth: stored oct_ runtime tokens minted via POST /api/runtime-tokens
environment.node: host Node v26.7.0 running pinned sources via native TS execution; image probes use node:24-alpine build

setup: stored client config is required for /v1 connect (clientConfig inline is only read at top level by POST /api/oauth/authorizations, see notes)

error.message: OAuth state is missing or expired.

steps.step: callback with the real stateHandle and a fake code — state is consumed, token exchange fails at the provider
poll after callback — request transitioned to failed

assertions: POST /api/oauth/authorizations → {authorizationUrl, state} exactly (state is a UUID)
authorizationUrl points at github.com/login/oauth/authorize with the configured client_id and redirect_uri=http://localhost:31701/oauth/callback (OOMOL_CONNECT_ORIGIN default)
unknown state → 400 invalid_oauth_state 'OAuth state is missing or expired.'
POST /v1/connections/:service/connect → data {authorizationUrl, stateHandle, connectionRequestId, status:'initiated', expiresAt=+10min}
GET /v1/connection-requests/:id → {connectionRequestId, service, status, appId, errorCode, errorMessage, expiresAt, createdAt, updatedAt}
real state + fake code → callback 400 provider_error and the connection request moves initiated → failed (errorCode provider_error): the state correlated the callback to THIS request
full connected transition (status connected + appId) requires a real provider authorization code — NOT available in this environment (blocked-env for that sub-step only; no fabrication)
notes: clientConfig fields are read from the TOP LEVEL of POST /api/oauth/authorizations body (clientId/clientSecret/requestedScopes/extra/secretExtra) — NOT nested under a clientConfig key (src/server/connect-server.ts:1238-1251)
/v1/connections/:service/connect accepts NO inline client config; it resolves the STORED config from PUT /api/oauth/configs/:service
custom client configs additionally require OOMOL_CONNECT_ALLOWED_CUSTOM_OAUTH=<service|*> and OOMOL_CONNECT_ENCRYPTION_KEY
